rv.q: A marvel... a carnival-style haunted house.
Those seeking something deeper in their theatrical outings may want to wait this out.
"Paranormal Activity" is such a well-conceived and thrillingly-executed production, it’s sheer intensity and can’t-look-away promise of increasing horror will make you a believer.
More importantly, it is deliriously, deliciously scary.
Paranormal Activity is relentless in building intoxicating anticipation from the first blaring sound cue.
In that way, Paranormal Activity plays.

cn.t: Critics praise this stage adaptation as a surprisingly effective "horror hoot" that delivers genuine scares and jump scares rarely achieved in theater, leaving audiences gasping and checking their doors on the way out.
